title: Amazing app
body:
1, no adds at all!!
2, completely free no need for premium or pay!
3, super organised!!
I was so unorganised I was scrolling down App Store trying to find the perfect habit tracker and this IS the BEST one!!!
author: Hehehehe0147

title: Why would you stop?
body: Good app, clean interface. Widget can be improved to make it more convenient to tick ( right now too small)
author: Lucas Phan

title: Unable to log successfully
body: i set up my habits and complete them but in not able to log it into the app once the time passes. and i’ve actually done it. it’s annoying because i can’t seem to log it in.
author: yxsc

title: Good and intuitive UI for a first time user
body: I came across this app while searching for a habit tracker and although it had little reviews, the UI caught my attention. After testing it out for 5mins, I will be using this as my habit tracker. Hope this app continues to be improved as I noted last version update was a year ago. Thanks for the hard work done on this app!
author: drowninglegs

title: No ads, no in-app purchases, and free to download!
body: Honestly, exactly what I’m looking for and so beautifully clean as well. Very easy to use and has a built-in journal feature in case you’re not able to write with a pen. Even had a nifty widget to add to your home page! Bless developers like Maximilian Munker.
author: @illest
